name: Boss Atlas
description:
## What it does

Shows configured boss and optional Metin spawn areas and names on the game's atlas.

## How to use

1. Install and enable Boss Atlas in Studio.
2. Launch your normal game client and enter a character.
3. Press M with chat closed, or click the atlas button on the minimap.
4. The enabled overlays appear on the atlas for the current map. Boss areas are gold; Metin areas are blue when enabled.

## Shortcuts

- M: opens or closes the atlas using the supported client's existing game binding.
- Boss Atlas adds no separate keyboard shortcut or standalone window.

## Settings

- Open Studio > Installed add-ons > Boss Atlas > Details.
- Show areas: display the configured spawn zones.
- Show labels: display boss and Metin names.
- Show metins: include Metin zones; off by default.

Close the client before reviewing and applying settings, then launch it again. The server can stay running.

## Good to know

The overlays describe saved spawn configuration, not live boss positions or a respawn countdown. Maps without an available atlas or indexed spawn data may show no overlay. Studio can be closed while you play.
